item.title: Dave Portnoy responds to people calling for The Duke to be banned from next year’s Internet Invitational
item.description: Photo by Theo Wargo/Getty Images The Internet Invitational has taken over the golfing world. Millions are tuning in to each episode to watch amateur golfers compete for $1.3 million. The field consists of players of all abilities, from high-handicap hackers to former PGA Tour pros. The barrier to entry for this event isn’t talent, it’s entertainment, with some of the best moments of the tournament so far coming from the worst golfers delivering their worst golf. But one player in particular, who goes by The Duke, performed so badly at this year’s Internet Invitational that fans called for him to never be invited back. Dave Portnoy responds to calls for The Duke to be banned from the Internet Invitational The Duke caused a stir at the Internet Invitational when he made it all the way to the penultimate round. He was put on a team with Ryan Ruffles, who had been the tournament’s best player up to that point, and Marissa Wenzler. In many fans’ eyes, that team’s fate was sealed the moment The Duke was put on it, and they finished dead last that round, sending all three players home. Many believed that he simply isn’t good enough to be in the tournament, and it ruins any player’s chances of winning if he is put on their team. Portnoy, however, believed The Duke didn’t play up to his albeit low standard. He said, “People say it should be Duke’s last Invitational. Let me tell you something. The Duke played so bad, and I’m not even saying he’s bad, we know that, but I mean bad for The Duke. Because he was f—–g nervous. “I think for the first time in the tournament, he’s smelling $1.3 million, which changes his life. He’d probably be dead to be honest. If The Duke won $1.3 million he’s probably dead, he wouldn’t be able to take it. “But I think he was smelling it and he got f—–g nervous. He was almost like a much different guy to a degree, and the pressure go to him which is the point of the tournament. “And he said, I don’t know if it was on camera I didn’t watch all of it because obviously I know everything that happens. But it’s like, ‘I get if you don’t invite me back. I get it. I had my chance, I totally get it if I’m not coming back next year.’ “So we’ll see. I don’t think a decision has been made on that either way. I think I’ve input enough where if I said, ‘we absolutely can’t have this guy any more’, I think Bob and Fore Play would value that. “But for the billionth time, I don’t make the list. I don’t invite people. I don’t pick them out, I don’t disinvite. Not me.” Admittedly, Ruffles and Wenzler also didn’t play their best golf either, as the nerves got to all three players. It seems harsh to put it all on The Duke, who was one of many high-handicappers at the event.

item.title: ‘Hard to find minutes’ – Mike Brown delivers brutal message to Knicks’ struggling $150 million star
item.description: Photo by Jason Miller/Getty Images New York Knicks head coach Mike Brown has shared his blunt take on the future of the team’s rotation amid one of his starters being stuck in the worst stretch of his career. The Knicks have rebounded from their 0-3 start to the season by going 6-2 over the last eight games to re-establish themselves as one of the clear-cut playoff contenders in the NBA. However, one of the reasons for New York’s struggles relates to one of their key forwards no longer looking like the star he was when the team acquired him and extended him on a four-year, $150 million contract. Knicks coach Mike Brown admits Mikal Bridges will be losing his minutes The player in question is former Defensive Player of the Year runner-up Mikal Bridges, who has averaged 5.9 points on 24.4 minutes per game so far this season. As he continues losing minutes to role players, coach Brown confirmed that he cannot afford to suppress the likes of Landry Shamet and Deuce McBride by forcing Bridges into minutes where he’s clearly struggling to perform. “We got two guys who are playing really well in Landry and Deuce. So it’s gonna be hard to find minutes at times for Mikal.” The Knicks sent the Brooklyn Nets the equivalent of six first-round picks a few seasons ago to acquire Bridges after the development he showed offensively while remaining one of the best perimeter defenders in the NBA. Now, Bridges is performing worse than the average role player in the NBA, while his defence has not been good enough to justify his minutes. He looks like a shadow of the player he was last season. With Bridges losing minutes, real questions can be asked about his future, as the penny-pinching Knicks would be better off parting with the $150 million they owe Mikal over four years and ensuring they open up the room to extend Josh Hart, McBride, and Karl-Anthony Towns. This is an inexplicable regression that both Bridges and the Knicks will hope can be addressed soon, as the franchise needs his high-motor perimeter presence and scoring threat to be the championship-winning squad we know them to be. item.title: Rice vs. Tulane: How to watch, date, time, TV channel
item.description: Will Swartz and Rice return home for an American conference game against Tulane on Saturday. (Matthew Pearce/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images) Rice returns home this weekend once again looking to end its long losing streak. The Owls (1-8, 0-5 American) have dropped eight consecutive games since beating Houston Christian in their season opener. Three of those defeats have been at home, two by one-score margins. Tulane (4-5, 2-3), meanwhile, is licking its wounds after being beat 60-10 by Tulsa in the Green Wave's homecoming game last week. The teams' head-to-head series dates to 1916, with Rice leading 20-17-1. The Green Wave have won each of the past two years in conference games. item.title: Red Sox Veteran Targets Return After Dominant Stretch
item.description: BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS - APRIL 22: Darwinzon Hernandez #63 of the Boston Red Sox looks on after allowing four runs during the tenth inning against the Seattle Mariners cat Fenway Park on April 22, 2021 in Boston, Massachusetts. (Photo by Maddie Meyer/Getty Images) Getty Images The Boston Red Sox could have an interesting opportunity to revisit a familiar name as they continue evaluating their pitching options for the 2027 season. The organization has several decisions to make this offseason, particularly when it comes to building a bullpen capable of supporting its rotation. While Boston will have plenty of established free agents and trade candidates to consider, the international market could also offer some intriguing possibilities. One former Red Sox pitcher has spent the past several seasons rebuilding his career overseas after struggling to establish himself in the major leagues. His departure from Boston came after command issues undermined some otherwise impressive strikeout numbers, leaving questions about whether his raw stuff would ever translate into consistent big-league success. Now, however, the 29-year-old left-hander is looking for another opportunity in MLB after putting together an impressive stretch in Japan. FORBES | By Peter Chawaga Red Sox Issue Sonny Gray Statement After Team Exit Former Boston Red Sox Pitcher Eyes MLB Return According to Boston Globe reporter Alex Speier, Darwinzon Hernandez is interested in returning to the majors after spending the last four seasons with the Fukuoka SoftBank Hawks. “Left-hander Darwinzon Hernandez, who improved his control and has excelled in NPB over the last four years (2.46 ERA, 31 percent strikeout rate, 8 percent walk rate), is looking to return to MLB. He turns 30 in December,” Speier reported . Hernandez originally reached the majors with Boston in 2019 after developing within the organization’s farm system. He spent parts of four seasons with the Red Sox, appearing in 91 games and recording an uneven 5.06 ERA across 85 1/3 innings. The left-hander always possessed considerable strikeout ability, fanning 32.3% of opposing hitters during his major-league tenure. However, his 17.7% walk rate proved difficult to overcome. Boston designated him for assignment in January 2023 before he eventually landed with the Baltimore Orioles. After being released that July, he signed with the SoftBank Hawks. His subsequent performance in Japan suggests he has made meaningful progress. Hernandez has maintained his ability to miss bats while substantially reducing the number of hitters he allows to reach base through walks. item.content:encoded: BOSTON, MASSACHUSETTS - APRIL 22: Darwinzon Hernandez #63 of the Boston Red Sox looks on after allowing four runs during the tenth inning against the Seattle Mariners cat Fenway Park on April 22, 2021 in Boston, Massachusetts. (Photo by Maddie Meyer/Getty Images) Getty Images The Boston Red Sox could have an interesting opportunity to revisit a familiar name as they continue evaluating their pitching options for the 2027 season. The organization has several decisions to make this offseason, particularly when it comes to building a bullpen capable of supporting its rotation. While Boston will have plenty of established free agents and trade candidates to consider, the international market could also offer some intriguing possibilities. One former Red Sox pitcher has spent the past several seasons rebuilding his career overseas after struggling to establish himself in the major leagues. His departure from Boston came after command issues undermined some otherwise impressive strikeout numbers, leaving questions about whether his raw stuff would ever translate into consistent big-league success. Now, however, the 29-year-old left-hander is looking for another opportunity in MLB after putting together an impressive stretch in Japan. FORBES | By Peter Chawaga Red Sox Issue Sonny Gray Statement After Team Exit Former Boston Red Sox Pitcher Eyes MLB Return According to Boston Globe reporter Alex Speier, Darwinzon Hernandez is interested in returning to the majors after spending the last four seasons with the Fukuoka SoftBank Hawks. “Left-hander Darwinzon Hernandez, who improved his control and has excelled in NPB over the last four years (2.46 ERA, 31 percent strikeout rate, 8 percent walk rate), is looking to return to MLB. He turns 30 in December,” Speier reported . Hernandez originally reached the majors with Boston in 2019 after developing within the organization’s farm system. He spent parts of four seasons with the Red Sox, appearing in 91 games and recording an uneven 5.06 ERA across 85 1/3 innings. The left-hander always possessed considerable strikeout ability, fanning 32.3% of opposing hitters during his major-league tenure. However, his 17.7% walk rate proved difficult to overcome. Boston designated him for assignment in January 2023 before he eventually landed with the Baltimore Orioles. After being released that July, he signed with the SoftBank Hawks. His subsequent performance in Japan suggests he has made meaningful progress. Hernandez has maintained his ability to miss bats while substantially reducing the number of hitters he allows to reach base through walks. FORBES | By Peter Chawaga Phillies Acquire New Backstop After JT Realmuto Decision Boston Red Sox Veteran Could Offer MLB Teams Low-Cost Option There are still reasons for potential suitors to exercise caution. Nippon Professional Baseball can be a more pitcher-friendly environment than MLB, and improved command overseas does not necessarily guarantee the same results against major-league hitters. Nevertheless, Hernandez could become an intriguing alternative for teams that miss out on more established left-handed relievers. “The lefty relief market is highlighted by Adrián Morejón but also features Alex Vesia, Steven Okert, JoJo Romero and plenty of others,” Darragh McDonald noted for MLB Trade Rumors . “For teams who miss out on those options, they could perhaps look to Hernández as a low-cost alternative.” For Boston, a reunion could offer an opportunity to evaluate how much Hernandez has changed since his previous stint with the organization. Whether the Red Sox pursue that possibility or another MLB club takes a chance on the left-hander, his success overseas has given him a new opportunity to get back to the majors. This article was originally published on Forbes.com

item.title: Dianna Russini explains how her husband gave her ‘perspective’ after Mike Vrabel scandal
item.description: Photo by Ethan Miller/Getty Images Dianna Russini made her official return on Wednesday evening following a number of months trying to stay out of the limelight after her offseason controversies. The former reporter for The Athletic is making an attempt to make it on her own after leaving the sports outlet after her relationship with New England Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel was made public during the offseason. Although she has been out of work for a number of months, Russini’s return has not come without criticism. The 43-year-old’s new show has been hit with scrutiny as she chose to address her controversies with Vrabel in a jovial manner. Dianna Russini brings her husband into Mike Vrabel controversy upon media return Following her return on Wednesday, Russini took to social media to thank everyone for helping her break an audience record with her new show. Although the views may have been there, some of her comments about her situation have left a bitter taste in the mouths of her viewers. “But first, a personal note.Over the last few months, I have had a lot of time to think about my life, my priorities, and the person I want to be moving forward. Being home in New Jersey with my husband and our two little boys, and being truly present, gave me so much perspective that I didn’t even know I needed,” she said. “I’ve also had a lot of long conversations with people all around football: some were about the game, and others were just about life. To the people who picked up the phone, checked in, and offered both encouragement and honest advice, from the bottom of my heart, thank you.” Russini has been spotted out in public with her husband since the situation involving her and Vrabel was revealed. Adam Schefter admitted he would still promote Russini’s work , if he was able to verify it, in what will be a boost for her going forward. There will be a long road back for Russini if she is to be taken seriously in the world an NFL insider, but the league has shown over the years that second chances are often provided to those who look to make up for their wrongdoing. item.title: JJ Redick Provides Updates on Doncic, Reaves and Sexton Injuries, Mamukelashvili Could Have Bigger Offensive Role
item.description: Los Angeles Lakers guard Luka Doncic (77) falls to the floor after injuring his ankle in the fourth quarter against the Milwaukee Bucks at Fiserv Forum. | Source: Lastwordonsports.com - Daniel Benjamin, Editor Although the Los Angeles Lakers left the court with a seventh straight victory Wednesday night in Milwaukee, it certainly came at a cost after injuries to three of their top contributors. Entering Wednesday’s game flying high after back-to-back wins in Detroit and Atlanta to begin their road trip, the Lakers had little trouble keeping the winning streak going en route to a 123-112 win. The Lakers (11-2) welcomed back guard Austin Reaves after he missed the previous game due to an illness. But after seeing Reaves exit the game in the third quarter due to a heel injury , Lakers coach JJ Redick said the team will need to undergo further imaging and testing before knowing the severity of the injury to their No. 2 scoring option. In addition to Reaves’ injury, the team saw reserve guard Collin Sexton exit the game with a facial laceration after an inadvertent headbutt by Bucks guard Ryan Rollins . Another injury scare came later, when Lakers superstar Luka Doncic tweaked his right ankle after coming down on Bucks forward Kyle Kuzma ‘s foot following a jumper. And while Redick says Doncic’s injury isn’t believed to be serious, the team will know more about Reaves’s injury on Thursday. “X-rays were negative,” Redick said while giving an update on the Reaves injury. “We’ll get imaging tomorrow. Probably no update besides that. Luka, I think, is fine—just a light tweak. And then, obviously, Collin is getting sutures in his temple or whatever area he got hit. But no update on AR until we have imaging tomorrow.” JJ Redick says Austin Reaves’ X-rays were negative, with additional imaging scheduled for tomorrow. https://t.co/4jyKiJdZbn — Spectrum SportsNet (@SpectrumSN) November 12, 2026 Reaves and Doncic Were Playing Well Before Their Respective Injuries Los Angeles Lakers head coach JJ Redick talks with guard Austin Reaves (15) and guard Luka Doncic (77) during the fourth quarter against the Memphis Grizzlies at FedExForum. Photo Credit: Petre Thomas, Imagn Images via Reuters Connect Before exiting the game in the third quarter, Reaves scored 18 points on 6-of-10 shooting in 25 minutes. He also grabbed three rebounds, dished five assists and collected three steals before appearing to suffer the injury on a dunk attempt. Now, the team awaits news on the extent of the injury, although Redick said it’s not believed to be an Achilles injury . JJ Redick told reporters that the Lakers have ruled out an Achilles injury for Austin Reaves. — Jovan Buha (@jovanbuha) November 12, 2026 Meanwhile, Doncic told reporters after the game that he’s “good,” and was more focused on the team moving to 3-0 on their current road trip. Doncic scored 32 points on 10-of-25 shooting and 5-for-12 from three-point range in the win, adding five rebounds, five assists and two steal
item.content:encoded: Los Angeles Lakers guard Luka Doncic (77) falls to the floor after injuring his ankle in the fourth quarter against the Milwaukee Bucks at Fiserv Forum. | Source: Lastwordonsports.com - Daniel Benjamin, Editor Although the Los Angeles Lakers left the court with a seventh straight victory Wednesday night in Milwaukee, it certainly came at a cost after injuries to three of their top contributors. Entering Wednesday’s game flying high after back-to-back wins in Detroit and Atlanta to begin their road trip, the Lakers had little trouble keeping the winning streak going en route to a 123-112 win. The Lakers (11-2) welcomed back guard Austin Reaves after he missed the previous game due to an illness. But after seeing Reaves exit the game in the third quarter due to a heel injury , Lakers coach JJ Redick said the team will need to undergo further imaging and testing before knowing the severity of the injury to their No. 2 scoring option. In addition to Reaves’ injury, the team saw reserve guard Collin Sexton exit the game with a facial laceration after an inadvertent headbutt by Bucks guard Ryan Rollins . Another injury scare came later, when Lakers superstar Luka Doncic tweaked his right ankle after coming down on Bucks forward Kyle Kuzma ‘s foot following a jumper. And while Redick says Doncic’s injury isn’t believed to be serious, the team will know more about Reaves’s injury on Thursday. “X-rays were negative,” Redick said while giving an update on the Reaves injury. “We’ll get imaging tomorrow. Probably no update besides that. Luka, I think, is fine—just a light tweak. And then, obviously, Collin is getting sutures in his temple or whatever area he got hit. But no update on AR until we have imaging tomorrow.” JJ Redick says Austin Reaves’ X-rays were negative, with additional imaging scheduled for tomorrow. https://t.co/4jyKiJdZbn — Spectrum SportsNet (@SpectrumSN) November 12, 2026 Reaves and Doncic Were Playing Well Before Their Respective Injuries Los Angeles Lakers head coach JJ Redick talks with guard Austin Reaves (15) and guard Luka Doncic (77) during the fourth quarter against the Memphis Grizzlies at FedExForum. Photo Credit: Petre Thomas, Imagn Images via Reuters Connect Before exiting the game in the third quarter, Reaves scored 18 points on 6-of-10 shooting in 25 minutes. He also grabbed three rebounds, dished five assists and collected three steals before appearing to suffer the injury on a dunk attempt. Now, the team awaits news on the extent of the injury, although Redick said it’s not believed to be an Achilles injury . JJ Redick told reporters that the Lakers have ruled out an Achilles injury for Austin Reaves. — Jovan Buha (@jovanbuha) November 12, 2026 Meanwhile, Doncic told reporters after the game that he’s “good,” and was more focused on the team moving to 3-0 on their current road trip. Doncic scored 32 points on 10-of-25 shooting and 5-for-12 from three-point range in the win, adding five rebounds, five assists and two steals. Doncic subbed out of the game with the final score no longer in doubt. And according to Doncic, he’ll be “fine” when the team returns to action on Sunday in Phoenix. “I’m good,” Doncic said . “Obviously, it’s painful a little bit, but I’ll be fine. We got to 3-0 on this road trip, so that’s very good.” Sandro Mamukelashvili Has Stepped Up in Two Straight Games Should the Lakers be without Reaves for a period, Sandro Mamukelashvili has shown he’s ready to assume more offensive responsibility if needed. Mamukelashvili scored 23 points off the bench in Monday night’s win in Atlanta. He followed it up with a second straight game of 23 points in 26 minutes off the bench Wednesday night, registering three rebounds, two assists and a steal in the win. Mamukelashvili connected on 9-of-15 shooting from the field and 5-for-8 from three-point range on Wednesday. And if Reaves is forced to miss time, Mamukelashvili could emerge as a key contributor for the Lakers on offense. Mamu opens up about rebuilding his confidence and finding the freedom to be himself with the #Lakers. 💜💛 https://t.co/jxbNiXHowr — Spectrum SportsNet (@SpectrumSN) November 12, 2026 The Last Word Los Angeles Lakers forward Ziaire Williams (11) dunks in the third quarter against the Milwaukee Bucks at Fiserv Forum. Photo Credit: Benny Sieu, Imagn Images via Reuters Connect In addition to the three players who suffered injuries, the Lakers were without Quentin Grimes for a second straight contest due to a finger injury. Grimes’ injury is a little concerning only because he was listed as questionable prior to being ruled out. Meanwhile, it seems that Redick is mainly concerned about Reeves heel injury. Heel injuries can be tricky, though most NBA players are back within a couple of days to a week, per Hashtag Basketball . But, depending on severity and the actual type of injury, Reeves could be out for up to a month. The good news is that the Lakers are off until Sunday when they close out their four-game road trip at Phoenix. If Reeves does miss time, Ziaire Williams figures to move back into the starting lineup, though Redick could go with Grimes. Williams has started five games, including the lone game that Reeves sat out, with the Lakers winning four of them. The 25-year-old has been highly effective whether coming off the bench or starting. Conversely, Grimes has been much more productive in his two starts than coming off the bench. But he has not been as efficient at shooting the ball in those two contests as he was the rest of the season. item.title: 'Another depressing moment' - Manchester United Supporters’ Trust slams ownership after Michael Carrick sacking
item.description: Manchester United v AFC Bournemouth - Premier League 2026/27 - Getty Images Sport Manchester United have sacked manager Michael Carrick following a disastrous start to the Premier League season. However, the club's prominent supporters' trust has swiftly shifted the blame towards the ownership, demanding immediate accountability for the ongoing crisis at Old Trafford. Carrick sacked after dismal Premier League start United have dismissed Carrick just ten matches into the new Premier League campaign. The club currently sit inside the relegation zone after securing a solitary domestic victory. Club executives met with minority owner Jim Ratcliffe in Monaco on Wednesday to decide the manager's fate. A subsequent official statement confirmed the extremely difficult decision to make a change in pursuit of their ambitions. Despite his rapid exit, the Red Devils paid tribute to the former midfielder as a club legend. However, his departure has immediately sparked fierce backlash from the fanbase regarding the wider structure at Old Trafford. Supporters trust direct anger at club ownership The Manchester United Supporters’ Trust (MUST) quickly responded to the sacking, describing the decision as another depressing moment for the club. They argued that the fundamental problems lie squarely with the hierarchy rather than the dugout. "Michael Carrick’s departure marks another depressing moment for Manchester United," a MUST statement read. "We thank him for his service and for restoring hope during the second half of last season. His standing among supporters remains undiminished. "The reason Manchester United fans have continued to support Michael Carrick in recent weeks is that they know that responsibility for United’s problems do not primarily rest with him or indeed his predecessors as manager. "They lie with the ownership. The Glazers’ debt-funded takeover continues to burden the club. When INEOS came in they promised sporting excellence, but yet with repeated changes in football leadership we have seen anything but." Deepening divisions and frustration at Old Trafford Frustration has been building both in the stands and on the pitch in recent weeks. Defender Lisandro Martinez notably criticised the hierarchy for failing to support Carrick in the transfer market following their recent Champions League defeat to Atletico Madrid . MUST also highlighted a deeper deterioration at the club, pointing to unprecedented booing and aggressive ticketing policies. They claimed supporters are being forced to pay the price for ongoing boardroom mismanagement. "It is time for the owners to explain themselves and show some accountability," MUST stated. "But the discontent at United is not just about matters on the pitch. Far from it. "Aggressive ticketing policies have further damaged relations with supporters. Treating loyal fans principally as a source of revenue undermines their identity and the bond with the team that sustains support through difficult times. Sup

item.title: Pierre Sage sacked by Crystal Palace after 16 games with club bottom of league

Thomas Frank, out of work since his dismissal by Spurs in February, has emerged as the main candidate to succeed Sage. item.title: FPL: Which Leeds United players have impressed so far?
item.description: FPL: Which Leeds United players have impressed so far? Leeds have teamed up with Fantasy Football Scout to help bring you hints, tips and advice during the 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) season. Scout will be using their expertise to provide advice and gameweek tips which should prove useful in ensuring you win your mini-leagues. Leeds United have made an encouraging start to the 2026/27 Premier League season and, as such, so have our players in FPL. All the regular starters in Daniel Farke’s side are on track to better their FPL points returns from last season over the course of the current campaign. Here we assess the underlying data and what that means for investing in Leeds players over the coming weeks. Leading the line: Dominic Calvert-Lewin (£6.0m) has had 19 shots so far this season. Of those, 17 have come from inside the box, 10 have been on target and eight have been defined as OPTA big chances. The England international is ranked in the top 10 forwards in the game for all of these metrics. Meanwhile, Anton Stach (£6.0m), Ethan Ampadu (£5.3m) and Jayden Bogle (£4.8m) have all created a team-leading 10 chances this season. Stach has started seven encounters while Ampadu and Bogle have been deployed from the off in every game so far. Summer signing Harry Wilson (£6.1m) has also created an impressive nine chances across his three starts and five appearances from the bench. Calvert-Lewin is top for expected goal involvements (xGI) across the Leeds side with a xGI of 4.76. This is sixth across all the forwards in the game. Bogle and Tarik Muharemović (£5.1m) are also posting some excellent attacking numbers, with Bogle third of all the defenders in the game for xGI. Muharemović has had seven shots this season, all from inside the box. A strong defence: However, it is not just Muharemović’s attacking numbers that make him one of the best defender picks in the game. The Bosnian has registered 14 Defensive Contribution points this season, the most of any player in the game. He has completed 112 defensive actions across the opening 10 weeks of the season, which only one player in the game can better. Seven members of the Whites’ squad have recorded Defensive Contribution points this season. Of the backline, Nico Elvedi (£4.5m) and James Justin (£4.5m) have registered six with Jaka Bijol (£5.0m) collecting four. The Leeds defence has kept four clean sheets so far this season. item.content:encoded: FPL: Which Leeds United players have impressed so far? Leeds have teamed up with Fantasy Football Scout to help bring you hints, tips and advice during the 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) season. Scout will be using their expertise to provide advice and gameweek tips which should prove useful in ensuring you win your mini-leagues. Leeds United have made an encouraging start to the 2026/27 Premier League season and, as such, so have our players in FPL. All the regular starters in Daniel Farke’s side are on track to better their FPL points returns from last season over the course of the current campaign. Here we assess the underlying data and what that means for investing in Leeds players over the coming weeks. Leading the line: Dominic Calvert-Lewin (£6.0m) has had 19 shots so far this season. Of those, 17 have come from inside the box, 10 have been on target and eight have been defined as OPTA big chances. The England international is ranked in the top 10 forwards in the game for all of these metrics. Meanwhile, Anton Stach (£6.0m), Ethan Ampadu (£5.3m) and Jayden Bogle (£4.8m) have all created a team-leading 10 chances this season. Stach has started seven encounters while Ampadu and Bogle have been deployed from the off in every game so far. Summer signing Harry Wilson (£6.1m) has also created an impressive nine chances across his three starts and five appearances from the bench. Calvert-Lewin is top for expected goal involvements (xGI) across the Leeds side with a xGI of 4.76. This is sixth across all the forwards in the game. Bogle and Tarik Muharemović (£5.1m) are also posting some excellent attacking numbers, with Bogle third of all the defenders in the game for xGI. Muharemović has had seven shots this season, all from inside the box. A strong defence: However, it is not just Muharemović’s attacking numbers that make him one of the best defender picks in the game. The Bosnian has registered 14 Defensive Contribution points this season, the most of any player in the game. He has completed 112 defensive actions across the opening 10 weeks of the season, which only one player in the game can better. Seven members of the Whites’ squad have recorded Defensive Contribution points this season. Of the backline, Nico Elvedi (£4.5m) and James Justin (£4.5m) have registered six with Jaka Bijol (£5.0m) collecting four. The Leeds defence has kept four clean sheets so far this season. Only two teams in Premier League can better that tally. We have also conceded the sixth-fewest big chances in the top-flight and the fifth-fewest shots from inside the box. With strong defensive underlying data, investing in a Leeds defender in FPL could be a very sensible decision. England international James Trafford (£5.0m) is having a fantastic season since his club-record signing in the summer. Of all the goalkeepers in the game, only two of the regular starters have conceded fewer goals than Trafford’s eight. The stopper has also made 37 saves this season, the second-most in the league which has resulted in nine save points. James’ 11 bonus points this season is more than any other goalkeeper.

item.title: Lindblad and Lawson to continue at Racing Bulls
item.description: Arvid Lindblad (left) and Liam Lawson have taken Racing Bulls to fifth place in the constructors' championship on 114 points, 45 points ahead of Alpine [Getty Images] Arvid Lindblad and Liam Lawson will continue as the drivers for Red Bull's second team Racing Bulls in 2027. Red Bull had been deciding whether to promote Bulgarian Formula 2 front-runner Nikola Tsolov in place of Lawson but have decided to spend a second season assessing their current line-up. Team principal Alan Permane said: "I have no doubt that this is the best driver line-up for us, bringing a strong combination of experience and ambition. "Both have demonstrated their ability and potential throughout the season, and we've seen the progress they've made, both individually and as a pairing." The decision to retain both marks a break from the previous Red Bull philosophy of fast-tracking drivers through the programme. Chequered Flag Extra: The Making of Kimi Antonelli Racing Bulls essentially exists to find potential drivers for the main Red Bull team, so the company has tended to jettison drivers who have been given a chance and not succeeded. That's why Lawson, 24, was considered vulnerable. He was promoted to Red Bull alongside Max Verstappen for the 2025 season only to be demoted after just two races in which he had struggled. The New Zealander has since sought to rebuild his career and was much more convincing when he was re-promoted to Red Bull for the Dutch, Italian and Spanish Grands Prix this year while regular driver Isack Hadjar was recovering from a broken wrist. Keeping Lawson on board for 2027 gives Red Bull a known-quality benchmark with which to continue their assessment of Lindblad, who made his debut this season. The 19-year-old Briton has excelled at times in his rookie year but on average has been a little behind Lawson, who has out-qualified him 13 times to nine and has scored more than twice as many points. Lawson said: "We've had a brilliant season together and the team has worked very hard to produce a fast car, which I've loved driving. "It feels great to be part of a historic season for the team as we continue our fight for fifth place in the constructors' championship. "I'm looking forward to carrying this moment forward with Arvid through to 2027; we're building something super positive and I'm excited by what we can achieve together." Lindblad added: "It's been a truly special year, full of new experiences and learnings since the very first pre-season test. I'd like to thank everyone for their trust and support. "I can't wait to get started next year, building on everything I've learned during my rookie season." The news release announcing the pairing made no mention of Tsolov, who is expected to be retained by Red Bull in some form of reserve role in which he gains experience through work in the simulator and with testing previous cars. item.title: ‘Pretty rough’… Bill Simmons calls out ‘weird’ NFL trade that reminded him of Mat Ishbia on the Phoenix Suns
item.description: Photo by Rebecca Sapp/Getty Images for The Recording Academy Podcaster Bill Simmons has called out the Jacksonville Jaguars for what he views as a risky all-in move at the NFL trade deadline. The Jacksonville Jaguars’ 6-2 start to the season has the team believing they can make a Super Bowl run. Quarterback Trevor Lawrence even received MVP chants during their recent win in Baltimore. The Jaguars were among the more aggressive movers at the trade deadline, giving up a 2027 first round pick and 2029 second round pick to acquire Jordan Davis from the Philadelphia Eagles. The move for the defensive tackle came after trades for Jessie Bates and Davon Godchaux, and followed injuries to DaVon Hamilton and Eric Murray. Speaking to his podcast , Bill Simmons called out the Jaguars for overpaying for Jordan Davis. He also compared the dealings to the moves made by the owner of NBA team the Phoenix Suns, Mat Ishbia. Ishbia went ‘all-in’ with the team when he traded for Kevin Durant and Bradley Beal to add around Devin Booker, but the move was not a success. Simmons explained: “The weird one was Jacksonville, Jordan Davis. They gave up extra picks, including a first for Travis Hunter [previously]. They now gave up a first for Jordan Davis. “This general manager, James Gladstone, he’s basically doing the Matt Ishbia, ‘I’m going to set all my picks on fire and try to win this season move’, which I’m not a big fan of. “The Jordan Davis thing was especially weird because nobody seemed to think he was playing that well. He was only playing half the snaps “I couldn’t believe how much they gave up for him. So Jacksonville is all in and they feel like rightly so that they have a chance to win the AFC, but I’m not sure Jordan Davis was the answer. “If you had asked me Jacksonville is traded for Jordan Davis, what do you think they gave up? I would have said a second because that would have been end of the second round because they’re going to have a good record. It was a first and a second. It’s pretty rough.” Jaguars have strong chance to win next three The Jaguars are already clear at 6-2 in the AFC South, followed by the trailing 3-5 Houston Texans. Liam Coen’s team could soon be out of sight. In the next three games they face the 1-7 Tennessee Titans, a 5-2-1 New York Giants team struggling at quarterback, and then the Titans again. They then face a possible Super Bowl matchup when they visit the Chicago Bears on the road, which will be a real test. item.title: Triton cabin crew’s medical certificate invalid during mid-air door incident – NSIB
item.description: By Dickson Omobola Nigerian Safety Investigation Bureau, NSIB, has disclosed that the flight crew of a Bombardier Challenger 604 aircraft, with nationality and registration marks T7-SEI, operated by Triton Aviation Limited, observed an abnormal increase in cabin altitude and suspected a pressurisation issue at 17:19, before its passenger-crew door detached during initial climb. NSIB also revealed that the cabin crew’s medical certificate was not valid at the time of that occurrence. Recall that on October 15, 2026, the serious incident occurred after the aircraft took-off from Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport, Abuja. The aircraft, operating as DWC052, was conducting a non-scheduled flight from Abuja to Murtala Muhammed International Airport, Lagos, with nine persons on board, comprising two flight crew members, one cabin crew member and six passengers. NSIB, in its preliminary report, stated that the captain subsequently instructed the cabin crew to double-check the main cabin door, adding that as the cabin crew approached the passenger-crew door to carry out the inspection, the door opened and subsequently detached from the aircraft. Director-General/Chief Executive Officer of NSIB, Captain Alex Badeh Jr, who signed the report, stated that the flight crew subsequently declared an emergency and coordinated with Abuja Air Traffic Control, ATC, for an immediate return to the airport. The report reads: “The aircraft landed safely on Runway 22 at approximately 17:34 local time. All nine occupants disembarked without injury. The aircraft sustained substantial damage. “Following notification of the occurrence on the same day, the NSIB immediately deployed investigators to the site to search for and recover the detached door, and commenced post-occurrence assessments. The detached door was subsequently recovered from a cornfield in Gui Village, Abuja Municipal Area Council, approximately five miles southwest of the airport. “The bureau reiterates that the preliminary report contains the factual information established during the investigation to date, including initial findings based on the evidence currently available and immediate safety recommendations arising from safety issues identified at this stage of the investigation. The report does not include analysis or conclusions regarding the causes or contributing factors associated with the occurrence, as the investigation remains ongoing. The bureau will publish its final report, including its analysis, conclusions, and further safety recommendations where appropriate, upon completion of the investigation in accordance with ICAO Annex 13 to the Convention on International Civil Aviation.” The post Triton cabin crew’s medical certificate invalid during mid-air door incident – NSIB appeared first on Vanguard News .

The bureau will publish its final report, including its analysis, conclusions, and further safety recommendations where appropriate, upon completion of the investigation in accordance with ICAO Annex 13 to the Convention on International Civil Aviation.” The post Triton cabin crew’s medical certificate invalid during mid-air door incident – NSIB appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Ancelotti keeps Brazil's system with a 'makeshift' forward
item.description: Ancelotti keeps Brazil's system with a 'makeshift' forward For the first time since arriving in Singapore, coach Carlo Ancelotti had his full squad on the pitch on Thursday and tried out changes to Brazil's starting lineup. According to ge, the Italian coach retained the 4-3-3 formation used in the previous two friendlies and tested Bournemouth forward Rayan in a deeper midfield role just behind Raphinha. Also according to ge, during the session at Jalan Besar Stadium, Bruno Guimarães took full part in ball work for the first time this week, lining up in midfield alongside Andrey Santos and Rayan. In goal, following the rotation plan established by goalkeeping coach Taffarel, Pedro Morisco has emerged as the leading option to start the match. Ancelotti's starting lineup featured Wesley, Jair, Gabriel Magalhães and Douglas Santos in defense, with an attacking trio of Estêvão, Raphinha and Vinicius Júnior. However, the coach left the battle for the left-back spot open. According to ge, Inter Milan's Carlos Augusto spent more time with the starters during training, leaving it unclear whether he or Douglas Santos will get the nod. To fine-tune the attack's movement, Ancelotti held an 11-against-zero tactical drill, with no opposition. In this exercise, Rayan moved through the central channel behind Raphinha, tasked with exploiting open spaces to finish moves inside the penalty area. With potential changes during the match in mind, the coaching staff also tested Marlon Gomes, Gabriel Bontempo and João Gomes in the first team. The Shakhtar Donetsk player was assessed in both holding and central midfield roles. Brazil face Japan this Saturday at 7:15 a.m. Brasília time at Singapore's National Stadium. item.title: ‘A league without emotion’: Hugo Cuypers opens up on why he left the MLS for Monterrey and Mexican football
item.description: ‘A league without emotion’: Hugo Cuypers opens up on why he left the MLS for Monterrey and Mexican football Hugo Cuypers has earned himself a first call up to the Belgian national team . The 29-year-old striker has been in fine form over the past few seasons, starting with his 51 goals for Gent in 90 games. In 2024 he left Belgian football to play in the MLS with Chicago Fire. Again, Cuypers was prolific, scoring 44 goals in 82 games. Yet this past summer he left the MLS and, in an interview with HLN , was hardly the biggest advocate for the league. Of the league, Cuypers said ‘ A league without emotion. Until the playoffs, it feels like you are only playing friendly matches. Whether you win or lose, it doesn’t really matter. Football is not a priority there ‘. With his side then deciding to sign Polish legend Robert Lewandowski to start the season, clearly Cuypers felt that his time was up. However, Cuypers could have stayed in the league if he wanted to. He revealed that there were offers from other MLS clubs to keep him in the league, hardly surprising given his record for Chicago Fire. However, Cuypers did not enjoy the league or the mindset of the owners. The 29-year-old said ‘ You have 25 clubs there that believe they will become champions because they have rich owners. But actually, they don’t even know how to win. Look, I struggled with that American mindset. That is why I turned down all offers from MLS clubs this summer ‘. What the MLS was to Cuypers is clearly contrasted starkly by his new club. Cuypers crossed the border into Mexico to join Monterrey, where he already has nine goals in 20 games. Unlike the MLS, Cuypers feels that football is a real priority in Mexico. Passionate fans and the level is what Cuypers decided was more important than what the MLS could offer, while also giving him a greater chance of making it into the Belgian set up under Mark van Bommel. That decision has certainly paid off for the striker. Speaking on his experience so far in Mexico, Cuypers said ‘ The atmosphere is incredible. There are a lot of red cards – they really go in recklessly over there – but the general level is better than in America ‘. GBeNeFN | Ben Jackson

item.title: Kendrick Perkins noticed something about Lebron James vs Celtics for the ‘first time’ ever
item.description: Photo by Emilee Chinn/Getty Images LeBron James was found wanting in the Philadelphia 76ers’ marquee game against the Boston Celtics, and Kendrick Perkins noticed something for the first time ever. In what was billed as a fight of the elites, the Boston Celtics dominated en route to a 123-101 win against the Philadelphia 76ers. LeBron James scored just 11 points on an ugly shooting night where he connected just one of his 3PT attempts, finishing with a +/- of -17. His teammates weren’t much better, but James’ performances had Kendrick Perkins noticing something for the very first time. Kendrick Perkins on LeBron James Usually, these are the kind of games where James’ light shines the brightest and he takes over through sheer talent and mentality. There was nothing of the sort against the Celtics as a much younger and athletic side ran rings around the 76ers and James. It is only one game, and it’s not wise to bet against James because he’s so driven as an athlete, but on the basis of that one game as evidence, count Perkins among doubters. Speaking on ESPN , Perkins said that for the first time, James looked “old” in his career. He said: “LeBron looked old for the first time. No, seriously, for the first time in 20-plus years, he looked old last night. And this is a prime example of why I’ve been begging and pleading for LeBron James to play more of the centre position. If I’m Nick Nurse, I stagger the minutes because it helps LeBron James offensively. LeBron is not just getting by anybody no more. “LeBron wants the mismatches. So now, all of a sudden, you either bring a bigger guy out on him on the perimeter, where he can get by them, or he has a smaller guy on him on the low block. “And you talk about a dynamic roller. LeBron James is still a hell of a screen-and-roll guy. So, if I’m Nick Nurse and I’m trying to figure out this offence, the best way to do it is go small-ball and put LeBron at the five, and then every now and then we see a sprinkle of him and Joel Embiid.” James has been averse to playing centre all his career, but the decision to move him there at this stage of his career isn’t very wise, despite what Perkins suggests. The centres in the modern NBA are athletic as well, and the bruising in addition is something James can do without at his age. If anything, a playmaking point guard role with shooters and runners around him will benefit him more. However, all these conversations based on one bad game are premature anyway. James doesn’t “look old” anymore. He is old, and it’s a testament to his fitness levels that he’s still contributing at such a high level. These games come with the territory at this stage of his career. item.title: Ohio State drops to historic low in CFP rankings
item.description: COLUMBUS, Ohio (WJW) — The Ohio State Buckeyes have hit a new low in the College Football Playoff rankings . Ohio State dropped to No. 20 in the latest CFP rankings released Tuesday, Nov. 10, marking the program's lowest position since the playoff rankings began in 2014. 2 Ohio cities rank among America’s best small cities The previous low was No. 16 in the first CFP rankings released on Oct. 26, 2014. The Buckeyes also fell outside the top 12 for the first time since 2017. The latest drop comes after Ohio State suffered its third loss of the season and second straight defeat. The Buckeyes started the season as the nation's No. 1 team, but after quarterback Julian Sayin was injured, Ohio State's season began to unravel. The Buckeyes are now 6-3 overall and 4-2 in Big Ten play. Loved ones mourn 2 women killed in wrong-way crash on I-90: ‘Horrible tragedy’ Ohio State remains mathematically eligible for the 12-team playoff field. The ranking also puts another streak in jeopardy. Ohio State and Alabama are the only two programs to appear in every CFP ranking since the system began. The Buckeyes host Northwestern Saturday. item.title: Kano APC group mobilizes non-indigenes for Tinubu, Abba Yusuf
item.description: By Omeiza Ajayi ABUJA: Members of the All Progressives Congress APC in Kano State have begun mobilising non-indigenes living in the state to vote for President Bola Tinubu and Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf in the 2027 general elections. They inaugurated a political support group, Asiwaju Kano for Asiwaju Jagaban (AKA), which is led by Kogi lawmaker, Hon. Leke Abejide and has set for itself a target of at least 1.5 million votes for Tinubu’s re-election. The Chairman of the AKA Planning Committee, Hon. Ekundayo Emmanuel, said at the inauguration in Kano that coordinators had been installed in all 44 local government areas of the state. “Today, we are inaugurating coordinators across all 44 local government areas. Our responsibility is to mobilise at least one million five hundred thousand votes from non-indigenes residing across Kano State for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, our esteemed governor and leader, the people’s governor, Engineer Abba Kabir Yusuf, popularly known as Abba Gida Gida, as well as all APC candidates in the state,” he said. Emmanuel said the group was established to promote the political vision of Tinubu and Yusuf, adding that structures were being put in place to meet its target. The Kano State Coordinator of AKA, Hon. Seyi Olorunsola, commended Abejide, who represents Yagba East and Yagba West Federal Constituency of Kogi State in the House of Representatives, for returning to Kano, which he described as the lawmaker’s place of origin, to give back to its communities. Olorunsola said Abejide had recently empowered more than 300,000 people in Kano, including nearly 5,000 widows. He said each beneficiary received N50,000, alongside bags of rice and wrappers. According to him, other politicians who rose to prominent positions through their connections to Kano had not undertaken similar initiatives to support communities in the state. He said Abejide’s decision to return and contribute to the welfare of residents showed his commitment to giving back to his roots. The Special Adviser to Governor Yusuf on Information and Communication Technology, Yusuf Sharada, reiterated the state government’s commitment to inclusiveness, saying Kano considers everyone living in the state a citizen, irrespective of place of origin. He described Kano as home to people from different ethnic and cultural backgrounds and encouraged them to keep contributing to its development. Speaking on behalf of the Yoruba community and other ethnic groups, the Chairman of the Yoruba Community in Kano, Olajide Johnson Ogunleye, called on members to treat the mobilisation exercise as a collective responsibility and work towards the group’s target. He urged them to take the message to their respective communities and rally support for the APC candidates. “It is a duty and a call to action for every one of us to ensure that this vision becomes achievable. item.title: Nobody defended Peter Obi like Yunusa Tanko in the North — Shehu Sani
item.description: Former Kaduna Central Senator, Shehu Sani, has said Yunusa Tanko was one of the strongest advocates of Peter Obi in northern Nigeria, following his departure from the Obidient Movement and appointment to the Social Democratic Party’s 2027 presidential campaign council. Sani expressed surprise at Tanko’s decision to part ways with Obi, given his commitment to promoting the former Labour Party presidential candidate in the North. In a post on X on Wednesday, the former lawmaker wrote: “Nobody in the Northern part of River Niger has fanatically defended and promoted Dr Peter like Dr Yunusa Tanko. What must have happened for Dr Yunusa to part ways with Dr Peter? Anyway, nothing is impossible in politics.” Tanko, who previously coordinated the Obidient Movement, was on Wednesday named national coordinator of the SDP Presidential Campaign Council for the 2027 election. His appointment was announced at the inauguration of the party’s campaign council in Abuja, where he pledged to work with its presidential candidate, Adewale Adebayo, and running mate, Usman Bugaje, towards securing victory at the polls. Explaining his political realignment, Tanko said he resigned as political adviser (North) to Obi on October 30. He linked the decision to his appointment to the leadership of the National Consultative Front (NCFront), following the death of its former co-chairman and ex-Speaker of the House of Representatives, Ghali Na’Abba. Tanko also disclosed that he had contacted Obi and the National Democratic Congress leader, Seriake Dickson, to inform them of his decision. He acknowledged their support during his time as coordinator of the Obidient Movement and expressed appreciation for their contributions. The SDP campaign coordinator said his relationship with Adebayo predated the latest appointment, adding that they had worked together since 2023 and shared a commitment to building a better Nigeria. He also described the SDP as a left-wing, people-oriented party that represents the interests of ordinary Nigerians, particularly those he said had been neglected. The post Nobody defended Peter Obi like Yunusa Tanko in the North — Shehu Sani appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Zamfara APC declares Hassan Dangaladima winner of rerun primary
item.description: By Idris Salisu, Gusau The All Progressives Congress (APC) has declared Hassan Umar Dangaladima winner of the rerun primary election for the Birnin Magaji/Kaura-Namoda Federal Constituency of Zamfara State. Dangaladima polled 9,416 votes to defeat his challenger, Aminu Sani Jaji, who scored 661 votes in the exercise. The result was announced in Gusau by Mustapha Muhammad, Acting Chairman of the APC Electoral Committee from the party’s National Headquarters, in the presence of party leaders and other stakeholders. Muhammad said the committee, having concluded its assessment of the exercise, was satisfied that Dangaladima secured the highest number of votes and was therefore duly declared winner of the rerun primary. Speaking shortly after his declaration, Dangaladima pledged to provide effective and meaningful representation for the constituency if elected to the House of Representatives in the 2027 general election. He called on APC members and supporters to unite behind him and other candidates of the party ahead of the polls. He also urged party supporters to work towards the success of the APC in the forthcoming general election. The post Zamfara APC declares Hassan Dangaladima winner of rerun primary appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: N10.8trn borrowing must deliver infrastructure, jobs – Agbese
item.description: By Gift ChapiOdekina, Abuja The Deputy Spokesperson of the House of Representatives, Philip Agbese, has urged the Federal Government to sustain effective budget implementation to translate Nigeria’s improving economic indicators into tangible benefits for citizens. Agbese, who represents Ado/Okpokwu/Ogbadigbo Federal Constituency of Benue State, said the proposed N10.8 trillion external borrowing must translate into infrastructure development, job creation and improved living conditions for Nigerians. He made the call while speaking with journalists in Abuja on Thursday, following the release of the Federal Government’s Second Quarter 2026 Budget Implementation Report and President Bola Tinubu’s request for National Assembly approval of a fresh external borrowing plan. Tinubu had on Wednesday written to the House of Representatives, seeking approval to implement the external borrowing plan contained in the 2026 Appropriation Act to finance budgeted projects and consolidate the macroeconomic gains recorded by his administration. The Budget Implementation Report, released by the Budget Office of the Federation on November 7, showed that government revenue stood at approximately N11.9 trillion in the first half of 2026. The report also indicated that Nigeria’s economy grew by 4.43 per cent in the second quarter, its strongest quarterly expansion since the third quarter of 2024, while nominal Gross Domestic Product rose to N119.29 trillion. The growth was attributed to improved crude oil production and resilient activities in the non-oil sector. item.dc:creator: Nwafor
item.content:encoded: By Gift ChapiOdekina, Abuja The Deputy Spokesperson of the House of Representatives, Philip Agbese, has urged the Federal Government to sustain effective budget implementation to translate Nigeria’s improving economic indicators into tangible benefits for citizens. Agbese, who represents Ado/Okpokwu/Ogbadigbo Federal Constituency of Benue State, said the proposed N10.8 trillion external borrowing must translate into infrastructure development, job creation and improved living conditions for Nigerians. He made the call while speaking with journalists in Abuja on Thursday, following the release of the Federal Government’s Second Quarter 2026 Budget Implementation Report and President Bola Tinubu’s request for National Assembly approval of a fresh external borrowing plan. Tinubu had on Wednesday written to the House of Representatives, seeking approval to implement the external borrowing plan contained in the 2026 Appropriation Act to finance budgeted projects and consolidate the macroeconomic gains recorded by his administration. The Budget Implementation Report, released by the Budget Office of the Federation on November 7, showed that government revenue stood at approximately N11.9 trillion in the first half of 2026. The report also indicated that Nigeria’s economy grew by 4.43 per cent in the second quarter, its strongest quarterly expansion since the third quarter of 2024, while nominal Gross Domestic Product rose to N119.29 trillion. The growth was attributed to improved crude oil production and resilient activities in the non-oil sector. Reacting to the figures, Agbese commended the Ministers of Finance and Budget and Economic Planning, Taiwo Oyedele and Abubakar Atiku Bagudu, respectively, for their roles in strengthening fiscal coordination and improving budget performance. He said the figures underscored the importance of effective fiscal management, improved revenue generation and coordination in implementing national development priorities. “These numbers show that deliberate efforts are being made to improve the management of our economy. We must acknowledge the work being done by the Ministers of Finance and Budget and Economic Planning to strengthen fiscal coordination and ensure that national priorities are reflected in government spending. “While there is still considerable work to be done, we should be able to recognise progress where it is being made. The figures indicate that the economy is responding to ongoing reforms, and the responsibility before us is to sustain that momentum,” he said. The Labour Party lawmaker said collaboration between the two ministers was important to achieving the administration’s economic objectives, particularly in strengthening revenue generation, managing public expenditure and directing available resources towards critical sectors. He added that regular assessments of budget performance were necessary to identify implementation challenges, measure progress and ensure that public funds were deployed in line with approved priorities. On the proposed N10.8 trillion external borrowing, Agbese said the request should be considered within the context of the government’s financing requirements and the need to sustain critical infrastructure and development projects. He said the proposal also presented an opportunity for the executive and legislature to strengthen cooperation in addressing the country’s development financing needs. The lawmaker, however, urged ministries, departments and agencies to improve budget execution and accountability to ensure that approved allocations delivered measurable results. Agbese maintained that the success of government spending and borrowing should ultimately be measured by their impact on the living conditions of Nigerians. “The ultimate test of any budget or external borrowing plan is its impact on the lives of ordinary Nigerians. Beyond the figures, we want to see better roads, improved healthcare, quality education, jobs and opportunities for our people. That is why budget implementation must remain a priority,” he said. item.title: Thugs attack NDC supporters in Lagos
item.description: Suspected political thugs, on Thursday, invaded a rally at Kudirat Abiola Way, Ikeja, Lagos, organised by the Nigerian Democratic Congress, NDC, supporters. The rally was organised as part of the ongoing campaign for the presidential candidate of the NDC, Peter Obi, and governorship candidate, Funsho Doherty. The rampaging thugs attacked supporters, with some sustaining injuries in the process. The hoodlums, armed with cutlasses, cudgels and stones, invaded the venue of the event, disrupted proceedings and sent participants scampering for safety. Though Obi was said not to be at the rally when the incident occurred, it was gathered that the thugs demanded money from the NDC supporters for holding the rally. When their demands were not met, the thugs resorted to attacking anyone on sight. A police source, who spoke on condition of anonymity, confirmed the attack. The source said the organisers did not obtain prior approval before the event. “Yes, it happened. However, it’s unfortunate that the organisers did not inform the security agencies of their rally,” the source said Vanguard News The post Thugs attack NDC supporters in Lagos appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Microsoft admits SQL Servers might wobble after October update
item.description: Encountered some odd SQL Server connection behavior since the October update? There might be a culprit… Microsoft has admitted that a change has caused linked server queries to fail to close connections. Linked servers via OLE DB providers have been around for years and are a useful way of, for example, using additional data sources in queries. Once a provider is added, SQL Server can open a connection to grab data, and close it again when the query is complete. Or, at least, that's the theory. The problem is that after the October 13 (KB5126646) update, connections created by SQL Server linked server queries might remain open. According to Microsoft, "As additional queries are performed, connections to external databases can accumulate instead of closing as expected. "This can slow or degrade server performance after prolonged run time." You think? Administrators will likely have already noted a suspicious number of open connections to external databases on affected systems. Microsoft said the issue affects SQL Server linked server queries that use OLE DB providers to connect to external databases. It gave PostgreSQL and Oracle as examples of connections known to be affected. And the fix? "If idle connections can be identified, it is possible to manually close them to temporarily relieve server load. "It is also possible to temporarily restore system stability by restarting the SQL service." The Windows behemoth went on to state the obvious: "However, these steps can also interrupt active queries or transactions, and the problem can resurface again after sufficient operation time." Bouncing a SQL Server to deal with connection leakage is less than ideal, although it would at least be a good failover test and, let's face it, having to restart Microsoft services regularly is something many administrators will be all too familiar with. There is a mitigation available, although only through Microsoft support for business. Otherwise, an out-of-band update should be along within the next few days to deal with the problem. According to Microsoft, the technical glitch affects every version of Windows except Windows 11 26H2, stretching back to Windows 10 1809 and LTSC 2019, and Windows Server from 2025 back to 2012. Microsoft, or rather the unfortunate souls responsible for administering their server products, has not had the best time of late. The October 2026 Windows Server update left some Exchange Servers wobbling until either a Registry edit was made or a fix was applied as part of the November update. ®

item.title: 2027: City Boy Movement targets 500,000 Enugu students for Tinubu
item.description: By Chinedu Adonu The City Boy Movement has launched a membership registration drive across tertiary institutions in Enugu State, targeting 500,000 students as part of its mobilisation efforts for President Bola Tinubu’s re-election in 2027. The South-East Zonal Coordinator of the movement’s Membership Registration and Data Management, Dr. Onyeka Nwafor, disclosed this during a membership registration exercise in Enugu. Nwafor said the movement had partnered with the Council of Students’ Union Government Presidents in Enugu State (COSPEN) to expand its membership base and mobilise students across campuses in support of Tinubu’s second-term ambition. He said the initiative was aimed at strengthening the movement’s presence in the South-East and demonstrating student support for the President’s administration. Also speaking, the COSPEN Chairman and President of the Students’ Union Government of the Institute of Management and Technology (IMT), Enugu, Comrade Emmanuel Nwankwo, said student leaders had endorsed Tinubu’s re-election bid, citing the impact of the Nigerian Education Loan Fund (NELFUND). Nwankwo pledged that the council would mobilise more than 500,000 students for the registration exercise. He spoke during a meeting with Nwafor at Tiger Bar, Enugu, where both parties discussed strategies for expanding membership registration and improving coordination across campuses. “Many of our peers would have dropped out of school because of financial constraints, but NELFUND has eased the burden on parents and helped students remain in school. For this, we believe Mr President deserves a second term,” he said. Describing COSPEN as the gatekeepers of tertiary institutions in the state, Nwankwo said the student loan scheme had helped address some of the financial difficulties confronting students. Nwafor, a former governorship aspirant of the All Progressives Congress (APC) in Anambra State, said the movement was determined to expand its presence across tertiary institutions in the South-East. “We have resolved to scale up registration across campuses in Enugu. The registration exercise will demonstrate the level of student support for President Tinubu’s administration, particularly the impact of the student loan initiative,” he said. He added that COSPEN would coordinate the mobilisation exercise through student union presidents across the various institutions. The post 2027: City Boy Movement targets 500,000 Enugu students for Tinubu appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: 47 Years Later, the Best 'Peanuts' Quote About Life and Death Still Hits Just as Hard
item.description: You can track the evolution of the American comic strip through its typical depiction of childhood. Early 20th century strips like Ernie Bushmiller's Nancy (1933) show kids' lives as relatively prosaic, particularly given the culture and publication standards of the time. While their child protagonists might have faced some incidental frustrations, the comics page was mostly about gentle humor. Yes, Sluggo is a homeless orphan, but no, that isn't a source of angst or conflict.

item.title: Michael Carrick was just the latest fall guy for Manchester United’s dysfunctional hierarchy | Jamie Jackson
item.description: Disastrous decisions and confused appointments have been a constant theme at Old Trafford since Sir Alex Ferguson’s retirement in 2013 For a window into the alarming dysfunction at Manchester United that Michael Carrick failed to manage and caused his sacking , consider the case of Eddie Howe, initially a favourite to succeed the 45-year-old before Mauricio Pochettino’s emergence as the chosen one. The former Newcastle manager had been Jason Wilcox’s choice to take over from Carrick. Howe was also the favoured candidate of Dan Ashworth, Wilcox’s predecessor as United’s director of football, to follow Erik ten Hag after the Dutchman’s sacking in October 2024. Except Wilcox disagreed and Sir Jim Ratcliffe went with Wilcox’s man, Ruben Amorim, and that December Ashworth departed only five months after joining. Continue reading...

item.title: Chinese woman accused of spying on Nvidia chief entered Taiwan 8 times
item.description: The woman accused of spying for Beijing during an affair with Nvidia founder Jensen Huang visited Taiwan a total of eight times in 2024 and 2025, a Taiwanese government minister said Thursday. Taiwan, a dominant player in the global semiconductor industry, sits at the centre of strategic competition between the United States and China, which claims the self-ruled island as part of its territory. Jensen Huang, chief executive of the US-based chip giant Nvidia, has admitted to having an extramarital affair, reportedly with Alice Huang, a former executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed who US officials believe was working for Chinese intelligence. Beijing has rejected the spying allegations. Alice Huang, who is also known as Huang Le, used a Hong Kong passport to enter Taiwan “under a standard business visitor status” and there were “no special flags” about her at the time, Mainland Affairs Council (MAC) Minister Chiu Chui-cheng told lawmakers. Chiu made the remarks in Taiwan’s parliament in response to lawmakers’ questions about Alice Huang’s entries into Taiwan and a New York Times report that the United States had advised Taiwan as early as 2024 to monitor her movements. “At least we at the Mainland Affairs Council did not receive any relevant information,” Chiu said. “If we had, we definitely would have stepped up our entry screening and border flow management.” Chiu said records show that Alice Huang visited Taiwan three times in 2024 and five times in 2025. The records do not show any entries for this year, he said. “If we had any of the kind of critical intelligence you mentioned, leading us to believe she posed a threat to Taiwanese society, we would have definitely flagged her for heightened review,” Chiu said. “For any case where there are doubts, we intensify the level of scrutiny, and if we determine there are security concerns, there is no way we would allow her to enter the country.” The government has said Taiwan’s security agencies are investigating the incident. Cabinet spokeswoman Michelle Lee said Thursday “there is currently no public information” about whether Alice Huang “is suspected of any criminal offence or on the related investigative procedures”. “If a criminal offence is involved, due to the principle of prosecutorial confidentiality during an ongoing investigation, we cannot provide any further comment,” Lee said. Alice Huang was seen at a dinner in May 2025 hosted by Jensen Huang at a Chinese restaurant in Taipei during Computex, the island’s top tech expo. Journalists stood outside the restaurant filming through glass windows and doors as Jensen Huang and a woman identified as Alice Huang, who was wearing a pink dress, mingled with other attendees. At one point, Jensen Huang can be seen putting his arm around Alice Huang as she kisses him on the right cheek, press livestreams show. The post Chinese woman accused of spying on Nvidia chief entered Taiwan 8 times appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Review: Apple's M6 iMac is pricey, but it's still a good choice for a clean desk
item.description: The Apple Silicon iMac got its fourth refresh this month. Every other Apple Silicon Mac has found a way to move forward over the last half-decade—we've gotten a more Pro design for the MacBook Pro, a mini-er design for the Mac mini, and a Mac Studio that has finally made Apple admit it doesn't want to make the Mac Pro anymore. But the Apple Silicon iMac has always been more interested in looking backward. It's the thin, screen-on-a-stand iMac design by way of the original Bondi Blue G3 iMac. It's a clean and pretty desktop computer, one I see all the time in small offices and on TV shows that depict small offices. We're long past the days when it was Apple's primary workstation computer. Read full article Comments

item.title: 2027: I was told to spend N500m before contesting — Accord Party candidate, Olajengbesi
item.description: By John Alechenu ABUJA — The Accord Party candidate for Oriade/Obokun Federal Constituency, Pelumi Olajengbesi, has alleged that he was told to be prepared to throw away N500 million before he could be taken seriously as a political contender in Ijesa North. Olajengbesi made the allegation in an open letter addressed to elders and stakeholders of Ijesa North, both at home and abroad, in which he urged the people to resist what he described as an attempt to extend the tenure of the incumbent lawmaker, Wole Oke, to 28 years. A copy of the letter was made available to Vanguard in Abuja on Thursday. Recounting his first attempt to join the political race, Olajengbesi said he expressed interest in contesting for the House of Representatives in August 2016, when he was 30 years old and had limited financial resources. He alleged that Hon. Niyi Ajifowobaje, whom he described as one of Oke’s prominent political associates at the time, told him that an aspirant in Ijesa North must be prepared to throw N500 million into a river before considering a contest for the Oriade/Obokun seat. According to him, Ajifowobaje further suggested that an aspirant would need as much as N1 billion to be taken seriously. “I was told to throw away N500 million before running in Ijesa North,” he said. Olajengbesi said he subsequently assembled a group of young people in the constituency on July 11, 2017, to examine the incumbent’s political strengths and identify alternative approaches to representation. He said the group produced a 16-page report, which he had incorporated into a book he was writing. According to him, the report concluded that money was the major political advantage the incumbent brought to the table, rather than ideas, innovation or inspiration for younger generations. “Money was the only thing he was bringing to the table. No ideas, no innovation, no inspiration, no storytelling, nothing to inspire younger people. Just money without excellence,” he quoted the report as saying. He said the report also observed that several professionals and educated people in the constituency were dissatisfied with the quality of representation but were reluctant to support a challenger unless they were convinced the person had sufficient financial resources to sustain the contest. Olajengbesi alleged that the incumbent had cultivated an image of political dominance that made some potential challengers believe they could not compete with his financial strength. He further alleged that Oke once boasted during a private conversation about his election spending and how he had dealt with previous challengers. According to Olajengbesi, Oke allegedly claimed to have paid for the return journeys of some aspirants based abroad and financially settled local contenders. He declined to identify the individuals allegedly mentioned in the conversation.
